Document: FAQ-14 "Can I change my boarding station?" (effective from 2025-06-01). Language: English.
Write each section below as 1-4 clear sentences for passengers, using ONLY the facts given.
Keep every number, amount, percentage, time, date and document ID exactly as given, using Western
digits (0-9) even in Hindi. Write dates in the YYYY-MM-DD form given. Do not add any other numbers,
rules, phone numbers, websites or contact details.
Sections (name: facts):
- "Answer": Yes, once, to a later or earlier stop before your destination, if done more than 24 hours before departure. No fare change.

sections.text: Yes, you can change your boarding station once to a later or earlier stop before your destination, provided you make the change more than 24 hours before departure. There is no fare change.
